candidates.tagline: $194M new road built to ease congestion triggers 1km queues immediately
candidates.story: Australia's Ison Road connection, a $194 million project opened 3 months early, was designed to finally ease peak-hour congestion in Wyndham — and instead immediately created kilometre-long traffic queues during peak hours.
candidates.why_funny: They finished it early and everything, and the road that was supposed to fix the traffic is now its own traffic jam.
candidates.alt: Cars bumper-to-bumper in heavy traffic on the new Ison Road connection in Wyndham, Victoria, Australia

candidates.tagline: Rocket Lab delayed its rocket to 2027 because the fuel tank has air bubbles in it
candidates.story: Rocket Lab announced on October 15, 2026 that its Neutron rocket's maiden launch is pushed to 2027 after engineers found microscopic voids (air pockets) in the carbon-composite forward dome of the first-stage propellant tank — a manufacturing flaw that knocked 11% off the company's stock.
candidates.why_funny: Years of development and hundreds of millions of dollars, and the showstopper is: there's air where there shouldn't be air.
candidates.alt: Artist's rendering of the Rocket Lab Neutron heavy-lift rocket in its stacked two-stage configuration
